A '''collector''' was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. The collector was in possession of the [[Scepter of Ragnos]] before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] when [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tavion Axmis]] murdered him and took possession of it.<ref name="JKJA" />
